description: In crates/core/src/group_log/append.rs, insert_entry succeeds and the entry is durably stored, then the process can crash before advance_tips completes. On restart the entry is in the log but never becomes a tip, so it is permanently unreachable via list_tips and invisible to reconcile/backfill. There is no recovery path: no startup scan for entries-without-tip-membership, no WAL, no compensating logic. The fix requires either: (a) a single atomic DB transaction covering both the log_entries insert and the group_tips update (requires both tables in the same DB, which is currently true for SqliteLogStorage), or (b) a startup reconcile that finds orphaned log entries and re-adds them as tips. Document the failure mode at minimum if the fix is deferred.
title: group_log append: crash between insert_entry and advance_tips leaves orphaned tip
